wiring: CCI master 0 at 0x36; L5 1.2 V core, L15 2.8 V analogue (camera-only on the stock Madai DT), shared GPIO64 I/O switch; MCLK1 on GPIO27 at 24 MHz; reset GPIO28; CSIPHY1 data lane 0 with clock lane 1 (stock lane mask 0x3); stock mount angle 270
clocking: Register sequence from NVIDIA's GPLv2 Tegra imx132.c; one lane selected with 0x3301 = 0x01 and the VT divider 0x30a4 = 2 (/1), per the AtomISP imx driver. PLL 24 MHz / 2 * 33 = 396 Mbit/s on one lane, link frequency 198 MHz, pixel rate 39.6 Mpixel/s, 2248 x 1226 per frame: 14.37 fps predicted

results.probe: chip ID 0x0132 read at probe; libcamera lists 'Internal front camera' and 'Internal back camera'
results.raw_stream: 10 frames at 14.37 fps, 2966400 bytes each (1200 lines x 2472-byte stride)
results.test_pattern: Colour bars (test_pattern=2), row 600, even columns every 124 px: 1023 x4, 64 x4, 1023 x4, 64 x4 - the red channel of white/yellow, cyan/green, magenta/red, blue/black bars. Confirms RGGB order, an intact 1976-pixel line and black level 64
results.real_scene: Phone on its back, front camera facing a dim room at night: soft ISP output 1968x1200 at about 7 fps written to disk; frame means settle at R 103, G 104, B 95 within 100 frames. Exposure (1222 lines) and gain (code 224, 8x) at their limits in this light
